changes.section: Epic Equipment Skill Effects and Weapon Skill Issues have been Fixed
changes.change_text: Ambidexterity — Fixed an issue where the Critical Hit Chance increase applied when attacking with an off-hand weapon differed from the tooltip.

changes.section: Epic Equipment Skill Effects and Weapon Skill Issues have been Fixed
changes.change_text: Temporal Leap — Fixed an issue where the effect that reduces the cooldowns of attack and control skills while active was being applied to the wrong type of skill.
sub_lines: Affected: Wand Blessed Barrier Specialization 2 [Targets Expanded], [Fountain of Life], Fountain of Life Specialization 2 [Range Increase]
